purpose: One explicit human-launched finite reviewer operation: synthetic dynamic-tool refusal admission followed, only if it passes, by one fresh scientific audit context. Existing subscription only.

model_policy.effort: highest recognized effort in the actual admitted model catalog
model_policy.if_identity_is_absent: Stop before model invocation and retain useful filtered catalog; PI decides a supported route from evidence, with no silent downgrade or paid fallback.

authorized_native_effects: The pinned native Codex process may read and refresh only the existing /home/afazeli2006/.codex/auth.json through a same-path writable file bind for this bounded operation. The parent never opens, hashes, copies, backs up, exports or logs credential contents; the parent directory remains unwritable.

Native inherited networking is permitted for existing-subscription authentication, necessary configuration/model/usage metadata and the bounded reviewer model requests. This is not a network endpoint allowlist. No paid API, purchases, credit resets, account replacement or new spending.

Existing host configuration, managed-policy origins, model/cloud caches, resolver and CA inputs remain exact read-only inputs. HOME, CODEX_HOME, original installation identity, account security and persistent configuration are not changed.

Each stage uses fresh project runtime state/log directories and a private same-value backing copy of the existing nonsecret installation identity. The native reviewer receives no project checkout or paper directory mount.

The parent owns a closed manifested evidence broker; the synthetic stage sees only synthetic files. The scientific stage gets a separately fresh process/state/thread and the frozen scientific packet with provenance-preserving full-page derivatives. No PI conversation/history is imported.

The model may inspect evidence, hash actual bytes, invoke the sole unchanged observer auditor and submit an exclusive structured verdict through that broker. The parent records the reviewer object unchanged and cannot choose its scientific outcome.

The fixed controller may request initialize/initialized, config and requirements/account/rate-limit/model reads, one fresh thread/start and one turn/start per stage, broker results and bounded turn interruption. It must refuse additional requests, tools, settings changes, model rerouting and permission escalation.
A complete report is reused. A partial or incompatible attempt is preserved and stops; publication retries never repeat the reviewer. No automatic native retry or unattended continuation.
constraints: Actual fresh reviewer admission must combine reverified existing mount/broker evidence, effective final source-sensitive restrictions and observed synthetic dynamic-tool refusal. Unattempted native operations are not labelled observed denials.

No broad home, Codex-home, project, session-bus or other-programme access; no shell environment, external MCP/apps, memory import, collaboration, code-mode host, browser, computer use or image generation available to the reviewer.
No configuration repair, client upgrade, credential handling by the Python parent, policy bypass, model metadata rewrite, result editing or unregistered experiment.

The named Codex meter is scoped to that native endpoint. Hosted ChatGPT allowance remains unknown and unattended model use remains unauthorized. The explicit human command does not measure continuous human attendance.

This prepared instruction-scope closure admits only the actually re-observed ChatGPT Pro account with null managed requirements. Changed plans or nonnull requirements stop without changing policy or configuration.
limitations: Native credential persistence writes in place; interruption or I/O failure can leave an incomplete file. The parent will not create a credential backup.
A catalog entry and successful thread construction alone do not establish model invocation; actual model access remains observable only during execution.
Finite time/context or method-inspection limitations may legitimately prevent a substantive verdict; preserve partial evidence and the reviewer dependency disposition if issued.
The initial model identity is retained explicitly; an absent exact match produces a useful catalog report rather than an assumed alternative.
